source_record_subset.mysql: SELECT `name` FROM `races` WHERE DATE_FORMAT( CAST( `date` AS DATETIME ) , '%Y' ) = ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT( CAST( `date` AS DATETIME ) , '%Y' ) FROM `races` ORDER BY `date` ASC LIMIT 1 ) AND DATE_FORMAT( CAST( `date` AS DATETIME ) , '%m' ) = ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT( CAST( `date` AS DATETIME ) , '%m' ) FROM `races` ORDER BY `date` ASC LIMIT 1 )
source_record_subset.cracksql: SELECT "name" FROM "races" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST( "date" AS TIMESTAMP )) = ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST("date" AS TIMESTAMP)) FROM "races" ORDER BY "date" ASC LIMIT 1 ) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST("date" AS TIMESTAMP)) = ( SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST("date" AS TIMESTAMP)) FROM "races" ORDER BY "date" ASC LIMIT 1 )
